resources.string: Android stops device-audio capture as soon as the screen locks or times out, and Recap can\'t restart it without asking you again.\n\nKeep the phone unlocked with the screen on for the whole meeting. Recap keeps the screen awake while it is in front, but not while you are watching in another app, so set a longer screen timeout first if you need to. If capture does stop, what was recorded up to then is kept.
Recording device audio — keep the screen unlocked
Device audio stopped — tap Finish to save

Android stopped device-audio capture. It does this when the screen locks or times out, or when screen sharing is stopped. What was recorded up to then is kept: tap Finish to save it, then start a new recording to carry on.
